volkswagen golf.running_notes: Generally cheap to run; 1.5 TSI and diesels need correct oil spec. DSG cars need gearbox servicing.
common_issues: DSG (DQ200 dry clutch) mechatronic faults and judder on some petrol automatics
Water pump / thermostat housing leaks on 1.4/1.5 TSI
Early Mk8 infotainment freezes and camera glitches
Rear coil springs can snap on higher-mileage Mk7s
viewing_checks: Ask for DSG oil-change stamps if it is an automatic
Check Digital Cockpit, ACC and cameras work on a test drive
Look for coolant residue around the thermostat housing
Inspect the spare-wheel well for damp

ford fiesta.running_notes: Very cheap to insure and tax. Powershift automatics are a known weak point — prefer manuals.
common_issues: Powershift dual-clutch jerks, flares and expensive clutch packs
Rear torsion-beam / spring cup corrosion on Mk7
1.0 EcoBoost wet belt (timing belt in oil) on some engines — check service history
Steering-column click and worn anti-roll bar links
viewing_checks: Avoid Powershift unless there is documentary clutch/gearbox work
Confirm wet-belt replacement interval on EcoBoost cars
Listen for rear suspension knocks over speed bumps
Check for rust around the rear beam mounts

nissan qashqai.running_notes: Popular family crossover. CVT smoothness and rattly interiors are the usual talking points.
common_issues: CVT hesitation or whine if fluid never changed
Panoramic sunroof rattles and drain-tube leaks (J11)
DAB / sat-nav reboots
Diesel DPF / EGR issues on short-trip cars
viewing_checks: CVT should pull smoothly from a stop with no flare
Open the sunroof and check headlining for watermarks
Confirm a recent CVT fluid change on higher-mileage examples
Check Around View cameras and parking sensors

toyota corolla.service_cost_band: £160–£280 independent / Toyota hybrid health check extra
toyota corolla.running_notes: Hybrid system is generally bulletproof. Expect excellent MPG in mixed driving and low wear on brakes.
common_issues: Infotainment lag and patchy smartphone mirroring on early cars
12V auxiliary battery can go flat if the car sits unused
Rear brake rust if used mainly on light hybrid regen
Paint chips on leading edges
viewing_checks: Ready screen should show hybrid system OK with no warning triangles
Confirm Toyota service history and hybrid inverter coolant service if due
Test Apple CarPlay / Android Auto
Check the 12V battery date

bmw 3 series.running_notes: 320d is efficient on longer runs. Timing-chain and oil-leak history matters more than spec boxes.
common_issues: Timing chain stretch on some B47/N47 diesels — listen on cold start
Oil filter housing and oil-cooler gasket leaks
Suspension bushes and rear subframe corrosion (F30)
iDrive / Sat Nav map-update niggles
viewing_checks: Cold-start the engine from stone cold and listen at the front cover
Inspect for oil around the filter housing
Full BMW or specialist history with oil changes at sensible intervals
Scan for DPF / AdBlue warnings on diesels

honda civic.running_notes: 1.0 VTEC Turbo is lively but needs oil on time. Diesel models are rarer in this budget.
common_issues: 1.0 turbo can suffer oil dilution / consumption if only used on short trips
Air-con condenser and lower-front corrosion
Infotainment reboots
Rear brake squeal
viewing_checks: Dipstick level and colour; ask about oil-use
Honda Sensing (ACC, lane keep) should track cleanly
Check front underside for stone chips and condenser damage
Full service history with Honda or specialist

audi a3.running_notes: Shares Golf bones. Haldex (quattro) and S tronic servicing are the cost spikes.
common_issues: Water pump / thermostat leaks on TFSI
S tronic mechatronics on neglected autos
Haldex pump failure on quattro if oil never changed
MMI glitches and reversing-camera failure
viewing_checks: Service pack for Haldex / DSG if fitted
Coolant level and staining at the front of the engine
Virtual Cockpit and sensors on a test drive
Check for liner issues only on older high-mileage TFSI (less common on later 8V)

vauxhall corsa.running_notes: Cheap to buy and insure. Corsa F (PSA) is a different car to the older GM Corsa E.
common_issues: Corsa E rear beam / brake-pipe corrosion
Low-speed stalling or timing-chain rattle on some 1.0/1.2 petrols
Infotainment lag on Corsa F
AdBlue / DPF on diesels used for short hops
viewing_checks: Inspect rear underside for rust on Corsa E
Smooth idle when cold
Confirm remaining warranty on newer Corsa F
Test reverse camera and parking sensors

kia sportage.running_notes: 7-year warranty is the headline if it is still transferable. Diesels want motorway use.
common_issues: DCT dual-clutch shudder on some petrol autos
Diesel DPF / EGR on urban cars
Infotainment / reversing-camera cameras
Front-arm bushes and drop links
viewing_checks: Confirm remaining Kia warranty and main-dealer stamps
DCT should not shudder at low speed
Check panoramic roof drains if fitted
Four-wheel-drive engagement on a short test drive if GT-Line AWD

hyundai tucson.running_notes: Similar recipe to Sportage. Warranty transfer is worth more than a slightly lower asking price.
common_issues: Dual-clutch (7DCT) low-speed judder
Diesel DPF on short trips
Rear shock leaks
Sat-nav map age
viewing_checks: Warranty remaining and stamped book
Smooth take-up from rest on DCT cars
No warning lights after a 15-minute drive
Inspect tyres for inner-edge wear (alignment)
